parts.name: Cap crown
parts.note: six panels, seams, topstitching, the band stitching

parts.name: Cap band edge
parts.note: the bottom edge of the crown, and the tape binding the opening

parts.name: Cap button
parts.note: the cloth-covered button where the six panels meet

parts.name: Cap eyelets
parts.note: an embroidered eyelet in each panel, to let the heat out

parts.name: Cap bill
parts.note: the visor: a curved board in cloth, five rows of stitching, the rolled edge

parts.name: Cap snapback strap
parts.note: two plastic straps across the opening, studs through holes

parts.name: Cap embroidery
parts.note: the Minato Seagulls gull: white on a navy edge, black wing tips, a yellow bill; its wings make the M of Minato

real.band: 57.5 cm round the band (sizes 55-60 by the strap), the sweatband 3 cm deep
real.crown: six panels; the front pair stiffened, about 11 cm from band to button at the front, 12 cm at the back
real.bill: 7 cm from the forehead, 19 cm round its root, 3-4 mm thick, curved across, five rows of stitching, green underneath
real.eyelets: one per panel, two thirds of the way up, 9 mm across with a 4 mm hole
real.opening: 6.5 cm wide and 4 cm high at the back, bound with tape
real.strap: two plastic straps 1.8 cm high: seven studs on one, holes on the other
real.embroidery: about 9 cm across the front panels, raised 1.5-2 mm

wear.about: How World fits this cap to a head (src/avatars/hat-assets.js): a point's place on the head it was built on (head: its centre and radii, metres) is carried to the same place on the wearer's head; the hair under the crown is pressed in to `tuck` (head radii) above the band, except in the opening above the strap.

head.recipe: the default adult (src/avatars/recipe.js DEFAULT_RECIPE): Rh 0.240555, width 0.94, height 1.08, oval
